opening_title: Allow to dynamically create fixture in plugin

expected_outcome.rationale: This proposes a public API to register/unregister fixtures dynamically from plugin hooks, unlike invoking an already declared fixture by injecting a usefixtures marker during pytest_generate_tests. The opening provides the multihost use case, failing fixture-dependency example, requested API and private-internals alternative. Proposal is accepted for the unresolved public API design; enhancement is equally defensible. Conservatively share the existing dynamic-fixture documentation family with 10156, whose later closure references this proposal; this does not assert a duplicate relationship to paired 12216.
